requirements.text: Provide the legal entity name and registered address.
Specify the proposed factory and country.
Provide contact details including email and telephone.
State the total estimated cost excluding GST and its validity period.
Specify the lead time and mass production release commitment date.
Acknowledge all addenda with their numbers and dates.

requirements.quote: Reproduce and expand this matrix in XLSX for all 38 IDs (HW, ME, SW, MF, QA, LG) and every subsection, table and commercial term.
requirements.text: Provide a compliance matrix in XLSX format for all specified IDs and terms.

requirements.quote: C = complies; PC = partly complies; NC = does not comply.
requirements.text: Use compliance codes C, PC, and NC in the matrix.

requirements.quote: Cite evidence for C; for PC/NC give the exact departure, alternative, cost/time impact and closure date.
requirements.text: Provide evidence for compliance and details for partial/non-compliance.
Do not use "Noted" as a compliance response.

requirements.quote: The undersigned is authorised to bind the bidder and certifies independent, non-collusive pricing; disclosure of conflicts and material subcontractors; complete scope pricing; and information accurate to the best of the bidder's knowledge.
requirements.text: Certify pricing, conflict disclosure, subcontractor details, and accuracy of information.

requirements.quote: All addenda are acknowledged and departures are confined to Form B and its attachments.
requirements.text: Acknowledge all addenda and confine departures to Form B.

requirements.quote: The bidder accepts reference checks, site audit and the stated offer validity, and understands that this RFP creates no purchase commitment.
requirements.text: Accept reference checks, site audits, and offer validity; acknowledge no purchase commitment.
